# Findings (generated by `python -m adauction analyze`)

## Warehouse

- Impressions: 16,468,027 across 675 campaigns, 6,142,256 users and 31 days
- Clicks: 5,947,563
- Conversion journeys: 438,730, of which 237,157 (54.1%) were attributed to Criteo
- Attributed conversions with their last click in the data: 216,528
- Spend: 4,829.34 (transformed units), CPA 0.0223
- ETL run time: 424 seconds

## Price paid

- The most expensive 10% of impressions took 63.1% of spend and earned 28.6% of attributed conversions
- CPA in that top group: 0.0492, vs 0.0054 in the cheapest half (which took 5.0% of spend and earned 20.9% of attributed conversions)
- Average value (cpo) of an attributed order: 0.055 from the cheaper half of impressions, 0.086 from the pricier half

## Frequency

- First impressions: CPA 0.0134, 25.1% of spend
- Impression 11 and later: CPA 0.0385, 16.0% of spend

## Conversion delay (from last click)

- Within 1 hour: 42.6%; within 1 day: 56.8%; within 7 days: 79.7%; after 7 days: 20.3%

## Bidding replay (days 21 to 30)

- Held-out attributed conversions: 64,805
- Training rows after negative downsampling: conversion model 1,101,424, attribution model 714,625
- Regularization chosen on days 18 to 20: {'conversion': 0.03, 'attribution': 0.03}

| Model | Label | AUC | Normalized entropy | Calibration | AUC on attributed label |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attribution model | last click of an attributed conversion | 0.859 | 0.794 | 0.92 | 0.859 |
| Conversion model | click followed by any conversion | 0.843 | 0.781 | 1.02 | 0.835 |
